brief:
Civil defense teams recovered the remains of a person from beneath a house in northern Gaza on Tuesday evening, Shehab Wire reported. The recovery operation was conducted as rescue and recovery efforts continue across the territory following widespread destruction from ongoing conflict.

Details regarding the identity of the deceased and the circumstances surrounding the death were not immediately available. The recovery underscores the ongoing challenge faced by emergency services working to locate and retrieve remains from collapsed and damaged structures throughout the Gaza Strip.
